title: Damien (TV series)
premise_summary: Damien is an A&E television series based on the horror film series The Omen, which serves as a direct sequel to the 1976 film of the same title and ignores the film's various sequels. The show was ordered as a series on August 25, 2014, by Lifetime, but was moved to A&E on April 29, 2015, where it premiered on March 7, 2016.
